newsitem.title: MEXICO: Pemex says Minatitlan refinery halts production.
newsitem.headline: Pemex says Minatitlan refinery halts production.

text.p: Mexico's state-owned oil and gas monopoly, Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex), said Tuesday it suspended activity at its Minatiltan, Veracruz refinery after a small fire was extinguished at 0220 local/0820 GMT.
The plant produced an average 228,300 barrels per day of petroleum by-products in 1994, according to Pemex.
Pemex said the fire in a a kerosene hydrodesulphurization unit was caused after "the rupture of a steam line."
Operations at the refinery will gradually return to normal, Pemex said in a statement.
Eight people were slightly injured because of the fire, which was controlled within 15 minutes, the company said.
